reviewScope: Host-to-view chunk transport generator, sender, Electron wrapper/ack/preload bridge, renderer receiver/assembler and size helper bindings from frozen files only. App-host RPC, worker schemas and feature coverage are separate investigations.

rangeConventions.start: inclusive UTF-8 byte offset in original frozen source
rangeConventions.boundsMethod: Babel parse AST functions/classes and small complete declaration/export spans located from exact original bytes; never formatted-code line numbers

existingEvidenceLimit: Earlier short locations establish bridge/channel presence. They are not complete function evidence for tokenizer, sender backpressure or reconstruction state machine; use new spans for these narrower claims.

evidence.claim: Frame marker is codex-host-chunked-message-v1.
evidence.claimScope: Only this transport marker; not an app-server protocol version.

evidence.claim: Token cost constants are 64 plus string UTF-16 length times 2 or 16 for non-string values.
evidence.claimScope: Estimation parameters, not exact serialized/network byte counts.

evidence.claim: Frame generator emits start at sequence 0, token batches with increasing sequence, and a final end. String segment target is max(1,floor(batchTargetBytes/4)); batching may exceed target for a single token.
evidence.claimScope: Generator output only; depends on tokenizer and caller-supplied transferId/batchTargetBytes.

evidence.claim: Tokenizer supports null/undefined/numbers/booleans/strings, arrays, recognized chunked arrays, and enumerable object entries. It rejects functions/bigints/symbols and cyclic values on the active traversal path; repeated non-cyclic references are traversed again.
evidence.claimScope: Tokenized branch only; not all inline Electron structured-clone semantics. Unsupported object classes are not explicitly type rejected: their enumerable entries are traversed.

evidence.claim: Short strings/keys emit a single value/key token; long strings emit string-start, UTF-16 slice string-chunks, string-end.
evidence.claimScope: Tokenized string/key path; final assembler concatenates slices. Boundary slices may divide a surrogate pair.

evidence.claim: Batch cost is 64 plus string UTF-16 length times 2 or 16.
evidence.claimScope: Approximate per-token cost; not byte-exact framing size.

evidence.claim: Recognized chunked arrays are flattened by iterating each chunk.
evidence.claimScope: Recognition is delegated to imported o.w; does not apply to arbitrary objects with a chunks property.

evidence.claim: Defaults are inline threshold 4194304 and batch target 2097152.
evidence.claimScope: Defaults only; constructor options can override both.

evidence.claim: Per-target sender keeps ordinary and critical queues with at most one chunk transfer active. It advances only after an ack matches current target/transferId/sequence and the part is marked delivered. Nonchunked critical messages may bypass a noncritical transfer. Loading requeues an in-progress transfer; destroyed/unavailable targets clean up. Deliver errors optionally retry; cleanup clears queues, transfer and subscriptions.
evidence.claimScope: Complete sender class. No explicit missing-ack deadline is present in this class; absence of a timer elsewhere is not established. Ordering guarantees apply per target and reviewed queue path.

evidence.claim: Electron sender wrapper supplies retry delay 1000 ms.
evidence.claimScope: Delivery-error retry only, not an acknowledgement deadline.

evidence.claim: Electron wrapper sends frame or inline payload on original channel, uses webContents destruction/loading availability, listens destroyed/did-start-loading/did-stop-loading, and removes lifecycle listeners on cleanup.
evidence.claimScope: This Electron webContents integration; not browser/other-host transport implementations.

evidence.claim: Ack handler validates [transferId,sequence] as a string and integer tuple.
evidence.claimScope: Shape validation only; sender further checks current transfer and sequence.

evidence.claim: Main receives ack on imported g.pt channel only from trusted IPC events, parses the tuple, then acknowledges using event.sender as target.
evidence.claimScope: Trust predicate and g.pt channel resolution are supplied by surrounding setup; this function does not define origin trust itself.

evidence.claim: Preload frame recognizer checks marker, string transferId, safe-integer sequence and kind; chunk frames require an array of valid tokens.
evidence.claimScope: Recognition used to distinguish chunk frames before shared-object side effects. It does not reconstruct messages.

evidence.claim: Preload token validator recognizes container/key/value/string tokens and the primitive value shape. A value token without a value property is accepted.
evidence.claimScope: Structural shape only; logical token ordering is handled by renderer assembler.

evidence.claim: Ack channel string is codex_desktop:chunked-message-ack.
evidence.claimScope: Constant used by preload acknowledgeChunkedMessage.

evidence.claim: Bridge ack API performs ipcRenderer.send(channel,transferId,sequence).
evidence.claimScope: Complete property function; no delivery Promise or retry provided by this API.

evidence.claim: Main host messages are dispatched to renderer as MessageEvent(message,{data:payload}). Recognized chunk frames skip the nonchunk shared-object cache/video-layout side effects.
evidence.claimScope: Complete listener callback. Final chunked shared-object handling, if needed, must be traced in renderer; preload does not apply cache side effects to assembled chunk messages.

evidence.claim: Renderer recognizes the same frame marker and token shapes as preload.
evidence.claimScope: Complete paired validators; logical ordering is delegated to receiver/assembler.

evidence.claim: Ack payload is only transferId and sequence.
evidence.claimScope: For validated/pending/complete frames.

evidence.claim: Start clears previous transfers and creates an assembler with nextSequence=start.sequence+1. Missing transfer or sequence mismatch deletes that transfer and returns pending with no ack. Valid chunk consumes tokens and yields ack. End deletes transfer, requires a complete value, and returns assembled message plus ack. Assembler rejects unmatched end/key placement/nested string chunks/missing string boundaries/incomplete or multiple roots. Object keys are assigned with Object.defineProperty.
evidence.claimScope: Complete lazy initializer containing both classes. No assembler exception recovery is present within these classes; behavior at upstream exception boundaries remains unverified.

evidence.claim: Window-message gate rejects foreign non-null source and incompatible same-window origin. Chunk receiver ack is sent before returning a completed typed message; pending transfers do not dispatch. Complete messages must be nonnull objects with string type.
evidence.claimScope: Complete function. Synthetic events with source=null are accepted, matching preload dispatch. Listener ownership/disposal and shared-buffer consumers need separate tracing.

evidence.claim: Chunked array representation is a class with chunks and length; o.w resolves to instance check ts.
evidence.claimScope: Static representation, not generic array-like values.

evidence.claim: o.w predicate resolves to ts(e), an instanceof $o test.
evidence.claimScope: Imported helper binding must be preserved or replaced with an equivalent explicit representation.

evidence.claim: o.T computes an estimated traversal size and compares it strictly greater than threshold. Strings count UTF-16 units times 2; primitive/object/key constants are counted; encountering a recognized chunked array makes the early-check estimate infinite.
evidence.claimScope: Complete estimate functions, not JSON byte measurement; source getter/proxy/enumeration side effects not runtime tested.

evidence.claim: Size traversal flattens recognized chunked-array chunks.
evidence.claimScope: Same special representation as tokenizer wG.

evidence.claim: o.C reads size from a WeakMap populated by cs. Sender can select a cached size on message/result/params before fallback traversal.
evidence.claimScope: Cache lookup only; callsites that populate this cache and their accuracy still require tracing.

evidence.claim: Export binding resolves imported helper used by sender.
evidence.claimScope: Static export getter mapping.

evidence.claimScope: Static export getter mapping.

evidence.claimScope: Static export getter mapping.

staticContractSummary.flowControl: One active chunk transfer per target; valid current ack gates each next frame.
staticContractSummary.serialization: Explicit token tree plus string segments; not JSON text chunks.
staticContractSummary.featureCoverage: No feature denominator or runtime coverage inferred from these contracts.

unverifiedBoundaries.question: Missing-ack deadline, abort and recovery policy outside sender class
unverifiedBoundaries.nextAction: Trace class callers and window-message error boundaries; use independent fault-injection fixture before choosing retry/abort semantics.
unverifiedBoundaries.impact: A successfully delivered part without ack may block that target indefinitely unless another lifecycle path resets it.

unverifiedBoundaries.question: Exception boundary when renderer assembler consume/finish throws
unverifiedBoundaries.nextAction: Trace message listener caller chain, logging and cleanup; verify fault path in fixture.
unverifiedBoundaries.impact: An exception can prevent acknowledgement and stall sender.

unverifiedBoundaries.question: Chunked shared-object cache update parity
unverifiedBoundaries.nextAction: Trace assembled shared-object-updated handlers and all getSharedObjectSnapshotValue users; verify inline versus chunked cache contract.
unverifiedBoundaries.impact: Preload cache is updated before dispatch only for nonchunk host messages.

unverifiedBoundaries.question: Size-cache creation provenance and argument contract
unverifiedBoundaries.nextAction: Find callers of exported cached-size setters and chunked-array constructors; correlate parent message/result/params paths.
unverifiedBoundaries.impact: Threshold selection uses estimates/cached values and may differ from raw payload bytes.

unverifiedBoundaries.question: Cross-window sender trust and complete listener disposal
unverifiedBoundaries.nextAction: Trace isTrustedIpcEvent setup, window types, frame allowlist and renderer subscription disposal.
unverifiedBoundaries.impact: Shape and current-transfer checks alone do not establish sender authorization or all lifecycle ownership.

unverifiedBoundaries.question: Domain caller coverage, transfer sizes and queue growth
unverifiedBoundaries.nextAction: Map send/sendInline/sendCritical callers and getPayload structures by feature; add realistic large thread/diff fixtures.
unverifiedBoundaries.impact: Transport is confirmed but individual Codex feature coverage/maximum memory use remains unproven.

unverifiedBoundaries.question: Runtime parity with Electron/Owl structured clone and custom data representations
unverifiedBoundaries.nextAction: Define supported serialization types and test both inline/chunk paths in intended independent runtime, after runtime choice.
unverifiedBoundaries.impact: Blind replacement by JSON.stringify changes undefined, special-array, identity and nonplain-object handling.

reproducibleValidationScenarios.name: Inline boundary and forced chunk path
reproducibleValidationScenarios.setup: Use reconstructed pure transport fixtures with ordinary typed payloads; record size-estimator result, not JSON byte length.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.actions: Exercise estimates below/equal/above configured threshold and constructor overrides.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.expected: Strict > selects tokenization; equal stays inline unless special representation/cache changes selection. Both routes reconstruct domain payload as intended.

reproducibleValidationScenarios.name: Large strings, keys, arrays and primitive preservation
reproducibleValidationScenarios.setup: Independent fixtures with long keys/string values including emoji at slice boundaries, null/undefined/false/zero/empty string, nested arrays and objects, special chunked arrays.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.actions: Generate frames and feed receiver; ack every accepted frame.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.expected: start/chunk/end sequence monotonic; no domain message before end; exactly one final typed message; UTF-16 slices rejoin; undefined and special-array semantics match chosen contract.

reproducibleValidationScenarios.name: Acknowledgement backpressure and invalid ack
reproducibleValidationScenarios.setup: Fake deliver target records frames; controllable acknowledgement.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.actions: Delay ack; send wrong target/id/sequence, duplicate/stale ack, then correct ack.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.expected: No next part before valid ack; invalid/stale acknowledgements do not advance; end ack releases transfer and resumes target queue. Missing-ack timeout must be explicitly decided because none exists in reviewed sender class.

reproducibleValidationScenarios.name: Per-target order and critical priority
reproducibleValidationScenarios.setup: Two fake targets; regular large transfer A, queued inline B and critical inline C; also critical chunk D.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.actions: Ack A gradually while adding all messages on target 1 and send ordinary message to target 2.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.expected: Critical inline can be delivered while noncritical A waits; ordinary B queues; critical chunk waits until transfer slot; target 2 progresses independently. Record exact observed order as contract.

reproducibleValidationScenarios.name: Loading restart and target destruction
reproducibleValidationScenarios.actions: Enter loading midway through transfer; reload, accept a new start; destroy target or mark unavailable.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.expected: Interrupted message requeues and restarts with a new transfer id; receiver start clears old transfer; destroy cleans queues/listeners/retry timer and sends no further parts.

reproducibleValidationScenarios.name: Delivery exception versus lost ack
reproducibleValidationScenarios.setup: Fake delivery fails first inline/frame send; retryDelayMs=1000 with controllable clock.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.actions: Advance timer and allow successful delivery; separately lose a successfully delivered part ack.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.expected: Delivery exception schedules retry and preserves pending work; delivered-but-unacknowledged transfer remains waiting in reviewed class, exposing recovery decision. Test retryDelayMs absent cleanup path separately.

reproducibleValidationScenarios.name: Receiver corruption and competing start
reproducibleValidationScenarios.setup: Synthetic validated frames in pure receiver harness.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.actions: Missing/duplicate/out-of-order sequence; new start before old end; malformed token ordering; premature end; missing string/container end; nested string tokens.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.expected: Out-of-sequence state is deleted without ack; new start clears prior state; logical token errors throw. Specify host recovery/error reporting without counting a guessed behavior as baseline.

reproducibleValidationScenarios.name: Origin gate and dispatch/cache side effects
reproducibleValidationScenarios.setup: Independent renderer/preload bridge harness with fake window and shared-object snapshot.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.actions: Pass foreign source, wrong same-window origin, null-source preload events; compare inline and chunked shared-object-updated flows.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.expected: Gate rejects foreign/wrong-origin events; source-null synthetic host events are accepted; no dispatch for pending frames. Determine whether assembled chunk updates preload cache through another path.

reproducibleValidationScenarios.name: Unsupported inputs and identity
reproducibleValidationScenarios.setup: Pure fixtures with repeated references, cycles, bigint/function/symbol values, dates/typed arrays/nonplain objects.
reproducibleValidationScenarios.expected: Token cycles/unsupported primitive types fail as static code specifies; repeated references are duplicated. Nonplain-object/inline semantic differences must be recorded rather than normalized silently.

suggestedImplementationBoundary: First-party host-message-codec + queued chunk sender/receiver contract in a shared transport package; Electron/preload IPC adapters separate. Preserve or explicitly replace special chunked-array and size-cache helper contracts. Do not merge app-host RPC or worker request buses into this protocol.
